# Tuya TV Viewer v0.5.0: first live video attempt

Experimental prerelease; video was not validated. Attempts a native P2P session and displays JPEG/MJPEG frames from a camera on Android TV without a NAS. The protocol and H.264 codec used by LSC Full HD cameras may be incompatible. Requires Android 7 / API 24, arm64-v8a, or an x86_64 emulator. App name and application ID remain `it.tuyatv.p2ptest`; varying debug signatures may prevent in-place updates. No personal credentials are included. Do not publish session data or full logcat output.
